title: Beauty & Personal Care
tagline: Hair, skin, nails, and wellness — licensed craft careers with real ownership paths.
summary: Beauty and personal care careers run on state licensure and clientele: cosmetology, barbering, esthetics, nails, and makeup, plus the wellness-adjacent care professions. This roadmap covers training and licensing, building a book of clients, and the booth-rental-versus-salon-versus-ownership business decisions.

sources.label: BLS OOH — Barbers, Hairstylists, and Cosmetologists

detail.description: Personal care spans salons and barbershops, spas and skin clinics, nail studios, makeup for events and media, and care professions like aides who support daily living at home.
detail.why: It is a licensed-craft industry where skill plus personality builds a clientele you own — with among the clearest self-employment ladders of any field.
